driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%. Scope limit of this measurement: judges saw the clean, full-text 11-entry menu, so the fan-out validates discriminability among the 11 descriptions - NOT routing survival under the listing-truncation pressure issue #43 describes; the post-merge /doctor budget check is the separate, remaining test of that.
description_measured: Patch a playable or creature race for Requiem via houseCARL — racial stats, skill bonuses, ability spells, and creature-trait keywords derived from Requiem's comparable race, emitted as an ESP override. Use for any RACE record: a follower race, or a modded creature taking the wrong damage or missing Requiem traits. Load before the RACE write — the Reqtificator skips races it can't classify.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies; no overrides applied. All nine expect=true rows (q1-q9) reason explicitly to I, naming RACE-record ownership and rejecting F (NPC_ actor), G (whole-mod plan), and E (spells) as near-misses; tokens match. All nine expect=false rows route elsewhere: q10 F, q11 D, q13 E, q14 G, q17 B, and q12/q15/q16/q18 NONE. The four NONE rows plus q13/q14 each considered I by name and rejected it on correct grounds (mesh/BodySlide asset work, cosmetic chargen preset, SkyPatcher INI delivery format, player build advice, spell-flavor "racial" vs the race record, cross-record lycanthropy needing the router). q14 is the only borderline call - the judge flagged G's "patch mod X" framing as a slight stretch but still chose G over I, so it stands as a specificity hit. Clean 9/9 + 9/9.
